```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```


# Tourists by area 

```{r}
visitors_region<-read_csv(here("raw_data/Tourism/Fiji_tourists_by_region.csv"))

prop_visitors_region<- visitors_region %>% 
  group_by(Country) %>% 
  summarise(Total_visitors = sum(Num_visitors, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  left_join(., visitors_region, by = "Country") %>% 
  mutate(prop_visitors = Num_visitors/Total_visitors)

visit_supp_table<-prop_visitors_region %>% 
  dplyr::select(-Total_visitors, -Num_visitors) %>% 
  pivot_wider(., names_from = "Area", values_from = "prop_visitors")


write.csv(visit_supp_table, here("tables/Supp_visitors_by_region.csv"))

```
